title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 1 章‧十六邦國
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 4 卷，1880／美國版 1898；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
mraot ahurô mazdå spitamâi zarathushtrâi,
azem dadhãm spitama zarathushtra asô râmô-
dâitîm nôit kudat shâitîm, ýeidhi-zî
azem nôit daidhyãm spitama zarathushtra asô
râmô-dâitîm nôit kudat shâitîm
vîspô anghush astvå airyanem vaêjô
frâshnvât.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda spake unto Spitama Zarathushtra,
saying:
I have made every land dear (to its people),
even though it had no charms whatever in it: had
I not made every land dear (to its people), even
though it had no charms whatever in it, then the
whole living world would have invaded the Airyana
Vaeja.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達對斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉說：我使每片土地親愛（對其人民），即使它毫無魅力：若我不使每片土地親愛（對其人民），即使它毫無魅力，則整個生存世界將會入侵艾里亞納‧瓦埃賈。

segments.orig:
paoirîm asanghãmca shôithranãmca
vahishtem frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô
mazdå airyanem vaêjô vanghuyå dâityayå.
âat ahe paityârem frâkereñtat angrô
mainyush pouru-mahrkô azhimca ýim raoidhitem zyãmca
daêvô-dâtem,
segments.en:
The first of the good lands and countries
which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was the Airyana
Vaeja, by the Vanguhi Daitya.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created the serpent in the river and
Winter, a work of the Daevas.
segments.zh: 我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，所創造的眾善土地與國家中，第一是艾里亞納‧瓦埃賈，位於萬古希‧戴提亞河。此時，安格拉‧曼紐來了，他是一切死亡，他反創造了河中的蛇與冬季，這是迭瓦的作品。

segments.orig:
dasa avathra månghô zayana dva hãmina taêca
heñti sareta âpô sareta zemô sareta urvarayå
adha zimahe maidhim adha zimahe zaredhaêm adha zyåscit
pairi-pataiti adha fraêshtem vôikhnanãm.
segments.en:
There are ten winter months there, two
summer months; and those are cold for the waters,
cold for the earth, cold for the trees. Winter falls
there, the worst of all plagues. [Hum 35: "Ten are there the winter
months, two the summer months, and even then [in summer] the waters are
freezing, the earth is freezing, the plants are freezing; there is the
center of winter, there is the heart of winter, there winter rushes
around, there (occur) most damages caused by storm."]
segments.zh: 那裡有十個冬季月份，兩個夏季月份；那些時節水是寒冷的，地是寒冷的，樹木是寒冷的。冬季降臨在那裡，一切災厄中最慘烈的。〔洪都35：「十個冬季月份在那裡，兩個夏季月份在那裡，即使那時〔夏季〕水也是凍結的，地是凍結的，植物是凍結的；在那裡是冬季的中心，在那裡是冬季的心臟，在那裡冬季奔騰環旋，在那裡〔發生〕風暴造成的最多損害。」〕

segments.orig:
bitîm asanghãmca shôithranãmca vahishtem
frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô mazdå
gâum ýim sukhdhô-shayanem, âat ahe paityârem
frâkereñtat angrô mainyush pouru-mahrkô
skaitîm ýãm gavaca dayaca pouru-mahrkem.
segments.en:
The second of the good lands and
countries which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was the
plain which the Sughdhas inhabit.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created the locust, which brings
death unto cattle and plants.
segments.zh: 我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，所創造的眾善土地與國家中，第二是蘇格達人居住的平原。此時，安格拉‧曼紐來了，他是一切死亡，他反創造了蝗蟲，這種蝗蟲會給牲畜和植物帶來死亡。

segments.orig:
thritîm asanghãmca shôithranãmca
vahishtem frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô
mazdå
môurum sûrem ashavanem, âat ahe paityârem
frâkereñtat angrô mainyush pouru-mahrkô
maredhãmca vîthushãmca.
segments.en:
The third of the good lands and countries
which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was the strong, holy
Mouru.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created plunder and sin.
segments.zh: 我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，所創造的眾善土地與國家中，第三是強大而聖潔的莫魯。此時，安格拉‧曼紐來了，他是一切死亡，他反創造了掠奪與罪惡。

segments.orig:
tûirîm asanghãmca shôithranãmca
vahishtem frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô
mazdå
bâxdhîm srîrãm eredhwô-drafshãm,
âat ahe paityârem frâkereñtat angrô
mainyush pouru-mahrkô bravaremca usadhasca.
segments.en:
The fourth of the good lands and countries
which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was the beautiful
Bakhdhi with high-lifted banner.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death, and he counter-created
the ants and the ant-hills.
segments.zh: 我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，所創造的眾善土地與國家中，第四是美麗的巴赫迪，舉旗高揚。此時，安格拉‧曼紐來了，他是一切死亡，他反創造了螞蟻與螞蟻丘。

segments.orig:
puxdhem asanghãmca shôithranãmca vahishtem
frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô mazdå
nisâim ýim añtare môurumca bâxdhîmca,
âat ahe paityârem frâkereñtat angrô
mainyush pouru-mahrkô akhemca vîmanô-hîm.
segments.en:
The fifth of the good lands and countries
which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was Nisaya, that
lies between the Mouru and Bakhdhi.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created the sin of unbelief.
segments.zh:
我、阿胡拉‧馬茲達所創造的第五個善良的邦國與地域是尼薩亞，它位於莫魯與巴赫迪之間。
隨後安格拉‧曼紐到來，他乃全然的死亡，他又反造了不信的罪孽。

segments.orig:
xshtûm asanghãmca shôithranãmca
vahishtem frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô
mazdå
harôyûm ýim vish-harezanem, âat ahe paityârem
frâkereñtat angrô mainyush pouru-mahrkô
saraskemca driwikâca.
segments.en:
The sixth of the good lands and countries
which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was the house-deserting
Haroyu.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created tears and wailing.
segments.zh:
我、阿胡拉‧馬茲達所創造的第六個善良的邦國與地域是棄家的哈羅尤。
隨後安格拉‧曼紐到來，他乃全然的死亡，他又反造了眼淚與哭號。

segments.orig:
haptathem asanghãmca shôithranãmca vahishtem
frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô mazdå
vaêkeretem ýim dûzhakô- sayanem, âat
ahe paityârem frâkereñtat angrô mainyush
pouru-mahrkô pairikãm ýãm xnãthaite
ýâ upanghacat keresâspem.
segments.en:
The seventh of the good lands and
countries which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was
Vaekereta, of the evil shadows.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created the Pairika Knathaiti, who
claves unto Keresaspa.
segments.zh:
我、阿胡拉‧馬茲達所創造的第七個善良的邦國與地域是瓦埃克雷塔，邪惡暗影之地。
隨後安格拉‧曼紐到來，他乃全然的死亡，他又反造了仙女赫嫩塔提，她緊貼著克爾薩斯帕。

segments.orig:
ashtemem asanghãmca shôithranãmca vahishtem
frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô mazdå
urvãm pouru-vâstrãm, âat ahe paityârem
frâkereñtat angrô mainyush pouru-mahrkô
akha aiwishtâra.
segments.en:
The eighth of the good lands and
countries which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was Urva
of the rich pastures.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created the sin of pride.
segments.zh:
我、阿胡拉‧馬茲達所創造的善地與邦國中第八個，是水草豐美的烏爾瓦。
其後安格拉‧曼紐降臨，彼乃死亡之總和，遂反造了驕傲之罪。

segments.orig:
nâumem asanghãmca shôithranãmca
vahishtem frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô
mazdå xneñtem ýim vehrkânô- shayanem,
âat ahe paityârem frâkereñtat angrô
mainyush pouru-mahrkô akha anâperetha shyaothna ýâ
narô-vaêpaya.
segments.en:
The ninth of the good lands and countries
which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was Khnenta which
the Vehrkanas inhabit.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created a sin for which there is no
atonement, the unnatural sin.
segments.zh:
我、阿胡拉‧馬茲達所創造的善地與邦國中第九個，是赫嫩塔，為瓦赫卡納人所居住。
其後安格拉‧曼紐降臨，彼乃死亡之總和，遂反造了一罪，其罪無可贖罪，即反自然之罪。

segments.orig:
dasemem asanghãmca shôithranãmca vahishtem
frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô mazdå
harahvaitîm srîrãm, âat ahe paityârem
frâkereñtat angrô mainyush pouru-mahrkô
akha anâperetha shyaothna ýâ nasuspaya.
segments.en:
The tenth of the good lands and
countries which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was the
beautiful Harahvaiti.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created a sin for which there is no
atonement, the burying of the dead.
segments.zh:
我、阿胡拉‧馬茲達所創造的善地與邦國中第十個，是美麗的哈拉赫瓦提。
其後安格拉‧曼紐降臨，彼乃死亡之總和，遂反造了一罪，其罪無可贖罪，即埋葬死者之罪。

segments.orig:
aêvañdasem asanghãmca shôithranãmca
vahishtem frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô
mazdå haêtumañtem raêvañtem hvarenanguhañtem,
âat ahe paityârem frâkereñtat angrô
mainyush pouru-mahrkô akha ýâtava,
segments.en:
The eleventh of the good lands and
countries which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was the
bright, glorious Haetumant.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all
death, and he counter-created the evil work of witchcraft.
segments.zh:
我、阿胡拉‧馬茲達所創造的善地與邦國中第十一個，是光輝、榮耀的海圖曼特。
其後安格拉‧曼紐降臨，彼乃死亡之總和，遂反造了巫術的邪惡作為。

segments.orig:
aêmca ahe cithrô daxshtô anghat aêm
cithrô-paiti-dayô ýatha kavacit jasen zaoyehe
ýâtumeñtem adha heñti ýâtumastema
adha taêcit uzjaseñti ýâ mereñcyâica
zaradhakhnyâica xshtãmicatca madhaxaheca.
segments.en:
And this is the sign by which it is known,
this is that by which it is seen at once: wheresoever
they may go and raise a cry of sorcery, there the
worst works of witchcraft go forth. From there they
come to kill and strike at heart, and they bring
locusts as many as they want.
segments.zh:
這是人們得以知曉的徵兆，
這是人們立即能見到的：無論他們
去到哪裡並高喊巫術的呼喊，那裡
就會發生最惡劣的巫術行為。從那裡他們
來殺害並擊中人心，並帶來
他們想要數量的蝗蟲。

segments.orig:
dvadasem asanghãmca shôithranãmca vahishtem
frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô mazdå
rakhãm thrizañtûm, âat ahe paityârem
frâkereñtat angrô mainyush pouru-mahrkô
akhemca uparô-vîmanô-hîm.
segments.en:
The twelfth of the good lands and
countries which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was
Ragha of the three races.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death, and he counter-created
the sin of utter unbelief.
segments.zh:
良好土地與國家的第十二
我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達所創造的，是
拉加的三種族。
此時安格拉‧曼紐來了，他是一切死亡，並反創造了
完全不信之罪。

segments.orig:
thridasem asanghãmca shôithranãmca vahishtem
frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô mazdå
caxrem sûrem ashavanem, âat ahe paityârem frâkereñtat
angrô mainyush pouru-mahrkô akha anâperetha
shyaothna ýâ nasuspacya.
segments.en:
The thirteenth of the good lands and
countries which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was the
strong, holy Chakhra.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created a sin for which there is no
atonement, the cooking of corpses.
segments.zh:
良好土地與國家的第十三
我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達所創造的，是
堅強聖潔的查赫拉。
此時安格拉‧曼紐來了，他是一切死亡，
並反創造了一種無法贖罪的罪行，
那就是屍體的烹飪。

segments.orig:
cathrudasem asanghãmca shôithranãmca vahishtem
frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô mazdå
varenem ýim cathru-gaoshem ýahmâi zayata thraêtaonô
jañta azhôish dahâkâi, âat ahe
paityârem frâkereñtat angrô mainyush
pouru-mahrkô arathwyâca daxshta anairyâca dainghush-aiwishtâra.
segments.en:
The fourteenth of the good lands and
countries which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was the
four-cornered Varena, for which was born
Thraetaona, who smote Azi Dahaka [Zohak].
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created abnormal issues in women,
and barbarian oppression.
segments.zh:
良好土地與國家的第十四
我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達所創造的，是
四角的瓦雷納，因為此地誕生了
斯萊塔奧納，他擊敗了阿茲·達哈卡[Zohak]。
此時安格拉‧曼紐來了，他是一切死亡，
並反創造了婦女的異常問題，
以及野蠻的壓迫。

segments.orig:
pañcadasem asanghãmca shôithranãmca
vahishtem frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô
mazdå ýô hapta heñdu, âat ahe
paityârem frâkereñtat angrô mainyush
pouru-mahrkô arathwyâca daxshta arathwîmca garemâum.
segments.en:
The fifteenth of the good lands and
countries which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was the
Seven Rivers.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created abnormal issues in women,
and excessive heat.
segments.zh:
良好土地與國家的第十五
我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達所創造的，是
七河。
此時安格拉‧曼紐來了，他是一切死亡，
並反創造了婦女的異常問題，
以及過度的熱度。

segments.orig:
xshvash-dasem asanghãmca shôithranãmca
vahishtem frâthweresem azem ýô ahurô
mazdå upa aodhaêshu ranghayå ýô
asârô aiwyâxshayeiñti, âat ahe
paityârem frâkereñtat angrô mainyush
pouru-mahrkô zyãmca daêvô-dâtem
taozhyâca dainghush-aiwishtâra.
segments.en:
The sixteenth of the good lands and
countries which I, Ahura Mazda, created, was the
land by the sources (?) of the Rangha, where people
live who have no chiefs.
Thereupon came Angra Mainyu, who is all death,
and he counter-created Winter, a work of the
Daevas.
segments.zh:
善地與善國中第十六個，乃我阿胡拉‧馬茲達所創造者，為蘭哈源頭之地，其地人民無有酋長。
爾時安格拉‧曼紐降臨，彼為全死之者，彼乃反創冬季，迭瓦之業。

segments.orig:
heñti anyåscit asåsca shôithråsca
srîråsca gufråsca berexdhåsca frashåsca
bâmyåsca!
ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
There are still other lands and countries,
beautiful and deep, longing and asking for the good,
and bright. [Hum2 54: lands and regions, beautiful,­deep, esteemed, brilliant and bright.]
segments.zh: 尚有其他善地與邦國，美麗而深遠，渴望並祈求善與光輝。（胡2 54：邦國與區域，美麗、深遠、尊貴、燦爛而光輝。）
